constraints_observed: Read only the assigned inputs and own outputs.

scope.evidence_basis: The supplied source pack is the evidentiary boundary. Neither the published article nor the works it cites were independently checked.

comparative_judgment.overall: A, B, C and D belong in the same strong quality tier. The evidence does not justify a decisive overall winner.
comparative_judgment.rationale: All four answer how documents help form practice, connect concrete episodes to ANT(LS), preserve teachers' active participation, and relate participation opportunities to the structuring authority of prepared material. A gives a successful broader account by including blackboxing; B develops the selected three episodes steadily; C is compact and makes the standardization claim precise; D provides especially clear local explanations of how proposals become revisable and how the role of prepared material differs across the selected encounters. These are small, partly preference-dependent differences, not a reliable overall hierarchy.
comparative_judgment.most_actionable_issue: C has a minor ambiguity in its bridge from teachers' images to pupils' participation: its wording can imply that the same images were traced across separate episodes. A wording clarification would remove that implication. This is not a demonstrated factual contradiction or evidence of invented data.
comparative_judgment.coverage_judgment: The omission of resource selection, resistance, workload, study sample details or Colton from a particular body is not itself a defect in this bounded subsection. Coverage is judged by explanatory function, not by the number of source-pack scenes included.
comparative_judgment.confidence: High that all four satisfy the core task and avoid major evidence errors; moderate in the fine stylistic comparisons; limited confidence in reading C's image continuity as more than a wording ambiguity.

length_check.method: Whitespace-delimited words; hyphenated items count as one. These are body-only files.

uncertainty: The assessment verifies fidelity to the supplied pack, not to independently inspected fieldnotes, interviews or the published full text.
The body-only review cannot assess attribution headings, editorial/source notes or drafting/review records, whose integrity is checked separately.
C's image sentence admits a generic reading; its possible implication of identical images warrants clarification but does not justify a charge of invented evidence.
D's comparison is locally supported; an interpretation of it as a universal teacher/pupil distinction would be stronger than the actual context requires.
Fine differences in concision, breadth and paragraph rhythm are editorial preferences. They do not establish a robust overall ranking.
